source.commit_note: Greptile capture/evaluation corrections and seven regression tests. The complete native Linux suite passed at this exact source commit; the following metadata freeze changes only the manifest and validation receipts. Historical CPU mock captures retain evidence_commit; no GPU inference or organizer submission is claimed.

suite.test_command: cd tasks/benchmark-design/suite && uv run --frozen python -m unittest discover -s tests -v

optional_tokenizer.real_run_requirement: --tokenizer-snapshot on runner and evaluator; selected assets must match plan.target.model_role
optional_tokenizer.cpu_validation: tests/test_model_tokens.py verifies both protected model tokenizer snapshots without weights or GPU

fixed_environment.measurement_harness_digest: UNAVAILABLE_IN_DRAFT: the fixed measurement runner has not been released (docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md); a candidate-built stand-in lives in tasks/benchmark-design/suite/runner
fixed_environment.agent_harness_release_digest: UNAVAILABLE_IN_DRAFT: the enhanced Pi harness release has not been published (docs/RELEASE_STATUS.md)

integrity.starter_tag: UNAVAILABLE_IN_DRAFT: no takehome-start tag exists in the draft repository; the only upstream commit was used as the base

evidence.compute_report: tasks/benchmark-design/validation/timing.md (measured CPU/mock wall time) and tasks/benchmark-design/validation/dry_run_full.json (planned GPU arithmetic)
evidence.gpu_runs: none: no GPU was available; every measurement is from the CPU mock

source.note: Exact implementation commit verified below; the following commit adds execution metadata and proof receipts only.

execution_revision.implementation: Self-contained candidate recorder, frozen raw-event schema, calibration, evaluator, timing audit and bounded lifecycle/export wrapper; durable prelaunch ownership checkpoint for outer hard-kill recovery; refuse incomplete startup/warmup calibration and independently audit malformed server chunks without consuming rejected text

workload.digest_scope: Exact committed canonical LF bytes; the raw run plan digest must match its actual file bytes
workload.calibration_policy: Separate complete baseline capture; freeze a new hash-bound plan before fresh scored captures; observed envelope with no extrapolation

planning_unmeasured.qualification: Arithmetic only. Calibration, quick and full are separate experiments; their combined allocation consumes the controller cash/deletion envelope. Actual full-suite timing includes setup, capture, analysis, export and cleanup.

validation.skip_reason: existing opaque held-out fixture key unavailable
validation.environment: Fresh native Linux clone of Windows Git bundle, no source overlay; pinned Tokenizers 0.22.2 and both protected-model tokenizer snapshots
validation.locked_ruff: 0.16.10 PASS; binary SHA-256 recorded in proof
validation.qualification: Candidate CPU software validation and independent JSON/hash/provenance checks; no official schema acceptance or grading result

measurement.required_next: Retain real baseline calibration and independent evidence verification, freeze measured time/noise/sample-count policy, then collect fresh controls and justified full scoring data.

execution_revision.official_interface_digest: NOT_CLAIMED: candidate-defined interfaces; no organizer release digest supplied

ownership_checkpoint.publication: Exclusive file creation, file fsync and directory fsync before launch; export allowlisted
ownership_checkpoint.recovery: Outer supervisor must retain the checkpoint/hash, verify exact container name/owner label/immutable image, remove only by observed full ID and independently prove absence after hard kill
ownership_checkpoint.scope: Candidate CPU-tested recovery authority publication; no GPU capture or cloud allocation deletion is claimed
